financial_items.title: MillerKnoll, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call (Revised 09/23/25)

financial_items.title: MillerKnoll, Inc., Q2 2025 Earnings Call (Revised 12/18/24)

financial_items.title: MillerKnoll, Inc. Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2025 Results
financial_items.summary: MillerKnoll's Q4 and full fiscal 2025 results showed net sales of $961.8 million for Q4, up 8.2% year-over-year, and $3.7 billion for the full year. The company reported a decrease in operating margin to 1.4% from 4.6% the previous year, highlighting challenges in maintaining profitability.
strategic_highlights: Positioning as a small-cap value firm

financial_items.title: MillerKnoll (NasdaqGS:MLKN) Stock Forecast & Analyst Predictions
financial_items.summary: Analysts forecast significant earnings growth for MillerKnoll, with an expected annual increase of 109.3% and revenue growth of 4.4%. The report notes that while revenue growth is slower than the US market average, the company's EPS is projected to grow substantially.
